core.purpose: The working text of iLang for a model that has never seen it: how to read, write, execute and judge it. Archive material, the formal declaration grammar and most worked examples are left out; the full bundle has them.

sources.layer: communication layer: the two syntaxes, the 88 verbs, modifiers, entities, declarations (v3.0 Final)
execution semantics: input isolation, budget, objective and task lifecycle, rubric, evidence, completion audit (v4.0 Final, current stable)
judgment layer: four axioms, the eleven-dimension vector, the decision modes and reference function, the entity registry and GENE correction (v5.0, public preview)

full.purpose: The complete text of the three core documents, for a model or a person that needs a part the core bundle leaves out.
